placements.why: The envelope's content is a ratified system design contract (async dispatch, receipt, cursor polling) — an organizational-strategy category for architectural commitments, not covered by any existing strata since none exist yet in this repo.
placements.title: System design commitments get ratified as durable contracts
placements.frame: What architectural commitment is being ratified, and what does it bind the system to going forward?

placements.title: Remember becomes a dispatch-and-receipt contract instead of a blocking call
placements.frame: What does the ratified async remember contract commit the system to — receipt issuance, cursor-watched extraction, and how the result reaches the caller (poll or piggyback)?
placements.why: Both expressions describe the same ratified design from the same present-tense, settled direction: Wynn narrates the ratification and its guarantees (receipt in seconds, cursor-polled watch, no blocking, no lost work), while Xena's assertive restates the identical mechanics as a 'key decision' — dispatch then poll-or-piggyback. No existing leaf covers this subject (graph structure is empty), so a new leaf is minted to hold this and future envelopes' contributions to the same contract theme; the position verdict already established these two as directional co-reference on one theme.
